texts.label: Siena, Concistoro 2308 fasc. 2 no. 10 (DECODE R4799)
texts.summary: A narrow undated slip: 'Et riuscendo o no la presura di Montepulciano, in ogni modo ragunato che sarà ...' ('whether or not the taking of Montepulciano succeeds ...'). The single cipher run of 25 signs was deciphered at the time letter by letter above the signs; no10.txt gives each sign with the letter written over it.

reading_review.note: v3 check 23 Oct 2026: the sweep scored transcripts/no10.txt, the sign-by-sign transcription with its gloss table and tentative clear lines (0.567). The cipher run is three words, 'presura di Montepulciano', every letter given by the contemporary gloss over its sign and consistent where a sign repeats; written out in its clear sentence (no10_reading.md) it scores 1.0 on explicit holes (plain 0.0 on one sentence: 'presura' with one s and 'Montepulciano' are unknown to the word list). Rests on the decipherment written at the time. v5 check 23 Oct 2026 (plain bar, VERIFY5_BRIEF): the slip is undated but of the Montepulciano campaigns of 1495-1511 (NOTES): older Italian, so the explicit-hole share is the bar (1.0); 'presura' and 'Montepulciano' are the only plain failures. Keeps read.
